## Change

What changed, why, and which user-facing behavior is affected?

## Verification

List focused checks and their outcomes. Distinguish synthetic tests from
real-provider evidence; include limitations and deferred checks.

## Compatibility And Privacy

- [ ] Defaults and accounting/wire-format compatibility are preserved or documented.
- [ ] Tests and relevant public documentation are updated.
- [ ] No secrets, raw prompts, identities, private summaries, or personal paths are included.
